predecessors.name: Ottoman Empire
predecessors.text: the Sanjak of Scutari, "created in 1479", which Mehmed Bushati "transformed ... into a semi-autonomous Pashalik of Shkodra"; with Bar and Podgorica

successors.name: Ottoman Empire
successors.text: the Pashalik of Scutari, dissolved after Mustafa Pasha Bushati surrendered at Scutari on 10 November 1831; infobox: succeeded by the Sanjak of Scutari and the Monastir Eyalet

ledger.x: 1757: Mehmed Bushati, "having eliminated two rival families", proclaims himself pasha of Shkodër and transforms "the Sanjak of Scutari, created in 1479, into a semi-autonomous Pashalik of Shkodra".
1780: Kara Mahmud takes Durrës ("In June 1780... eventually took possession of Durrës").
1785: Kara Mahmud attacks and defeats Montenegro.
1785: Venice pays haraç to the pasha.
1795: "he conquered parts of Southern Albania and much of Kosovo".
Page silent on the date: the Pashalik page says the peak held "western Macedonia" and the 1831 demand names Debar, Ohrid, Elbasan and Trgovište.
1796: "Kara Mahmud was killed and decapitated in battle" at Krusi on 22 September after losing at Martinići in July; the Montenegrin tribes keep their mountains.

22 September 1796: Kara Mahmud "was killed and decapitated in battle" at Krusi; the Montenegrin victory brought the Bjelopavlići and Piperi into Montenegro (Prince-Bishopric infobox: "Unification of (old) Montenegro and the Hills (1796)").
1796: Kara Mahmud dies; the tribute is not mentioned again by the pages opened.
1824: Ohrid and Elbasan come to the Bushatis after Ali Pasha of Yanina's fall (he died in January 1822).
March 1831: the pasha rebels against Mahmud II and marches into Macedonia; routed at Skopje in early May.
10 November 1831: Mustafa Pasha Bushati surrenders in Scutari after a six-month siege.
1831: "Mehmed Reshid Pasha besieged Rozafa castle and forced the surrender of the last pasha Mustafa Bushati"; the pashalik is dissolved and its land returns to the sanjak and the Monastir Eyalet.

wars.name: Kara Mahmud Bushati's campaigns against Montenegro
wars.outcome: Kara Mahmud defeated Montenegro in 1785 in four days; in 1796 he lost at Martinići (July) and was killed at the Battle of Krusi (22 September 1796).

wars.name: Revolt of Mustafa Pasha Bushati against Mahmud II
wars.outcome: The Porte demanded Dukakin, Debar, Elbasan, Ohrid and Trgovište; Mustafa was routed at Skopje in early May 1831 and surrendered Scutari on 10 November 1831.

certainty.note: A de facto autonomous pashalik with no treaty frontier; the extent of every period rests on the places named in the pages, and the Pashalik page's peak extent (southeastern Serbia, most of Montenegro) is wider than anything dated.
